title: An Information-theoretic Propagation Denoising and Fusion Framework for Fake News Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.02259v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Incomplete propagation data significantly hinders robust fake news detection. Recent approaches leverage large language models to simulate missing user interactions via role-playing, thereby enriching propagation with synthetic signals. However, such propagation data is intrinsically unreliable, and directly fusing it can lead to biased representations and limited detection performance. In this paper, we alleviate the unreliability of synthetic propagation from the mutual information perspective and propose a novel information-theoretic propagation denoising and fusion (InfoPDF) framework to learn effective representations from both real and synthetic propagation. Specifically, we first generate attribute-specific synthetic propagation using large language models. translated_title: 一种基于信息论的传播去噪与融合框架用于虚假新闻检测
translated_abstract: 摘要：不完整的传播数据严重阻碍了稳健的虚假新闻检测。近期方法利用大型语言模型通过角色扮演模拟缺失的用户交互，从而用合成信号丰富传播过程。然而，此类传播数据本质上不可靠，直接融合可能导致表示偏差和检测性能受限。在本文中，我们从互信息角度缓解合成传播的不可靠性，并提出一种新颖的基于信息论的传播去噪与融合（InfoPDF）框架，以从真实和合成传播中学习有效表示。具体而言，我们首先使用大型语言模型生成属性特定的合成传播。然后，我们将每个合成传播图建模为概率潜在分布，以引导与真实传播的可靠性感知自适应融合。在训练过程中，我们...
tldr: 本文提出一种基于信息论的传播去噪与融合框架，通过概率潜在分布建模合成传播并实现可靠性感知融合，有效缓解不完整传播数据中的不可靠性，提升虚假新闻检测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an information-theoretic propagation denoising and fusion framework that models synthetic propagation as probabilistic latent distributions for reliability-aware fusion, effectively mitigating unreliability in incomplete propagation data to improve fake news detection.
